name: Vampire Bloodlines: War Games
storyline:
Set during World War II, War Games follows a new story within the World of Darkness, taking players through locations including Portsmouth, Paris, Berlin, and Zurich.

As the war unfolds across Europe, the player becomes entangled in the affairs of vampire society, encountering local rulers, supernatural threats, investigations, and conflicts unfolding in the shadows of the war.
summary:
Vampire Bloodlines: War Games is a total conversion mod for Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines that introduces an entirely new single-player campaign set during World War II.

The mod features new locations, quests, characters, dialogue, environments, and boss encounters, while retaining the role-playing, exploration, dialogue, and combat systems of the original game. The final version, 6.0, was released in February 2026 after seven years of development.
